script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The statement that Gibeon had a treaty is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The passage says the merrymakers groan and the instruments fall silent. It does not say anyone was dancing or that dancing stopped.
The verse says the strong drink is bitter, but it does not say its taste changed.
The verse does not say the drink was previously sweet or that it stopped being enjoyable.
The verse says the drink is bitter, not that nobody who drinks it is refreshed.
The passage does not say that dancing had been taking place or had stopped.
The passage does not say the gate was what kept the city together.
The verse says singing is heard from the ends of the earth, not that the whole earth is singing.
The text does not say the prophet speaks loudly.
The pop-up joke makes light of the serious danger described in the passage.
The verse describes fleeing panic and climbing from the pit; it does not say that every possible way out leads to another danger.
